plan.title: Renew what is due
plan.summary: Checks both root cards, renews acme-ca and acme-release, and builds the next trust files. Nothing happens until you run it on the ceremony machine.

steps.title: Check the plan
steps.detail: ritueel compares the plan with the bundle and with the ledger, and asks you to type the first eight characters of the digest: 7f3a9c1e.

steps.title: Read both root cards
steps.detail: Reads every slot of root card one and root card two and compares them with the built-in layout. Nothing is written to the cards.

steps.title: Prove the root cards are alive
steps.detail: Each root card passes the proof of life. Its steps are fixed when the check is built.

steps.title: Renew acme-ca
steps.detail: Certifies the key of the requester acme-gateway again under acme root, side B, for 13 months from the day of the ceremony. The old certificate stays valid until it ends.

steps.title: Renew acme-release
steps.detail: Binds the release subkey again under the OpenPGP primary of acme, side B, for 13 months. The subkey is read with the admin role named in the configuration.
steps.whatChanges: A new binding for the release subkey

steps.title: Build the trust files
steps.detail: Builds the root list, the CA bundle, the CRL, the SSH CA key list and the keyring as trust sequence 9. The root of the year signs the root list; the roots stay the same, so one signature is enough.

steps.title: Write the record
steps.detail: Writes the record of this ceremony, which names the one before it, and its transcript.
steps.whatChanges: One new record in the ledger
